title: Product Support Analyst
description: Product Support Analyst responsible for L1/L2 application support, incident and ticket management, troubleshooting application and data issues, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL investigation, Unix/Linux troubleshooting, Control-M scheduled job monitoring, REST API and JSON integration troubleshooting, root cause analysis, SLA-aware escalation, and operational documentation. Experience supporting enterprise applications and working with technical teams is preferred. Responsibilities include investigating incidents, validating fixes, documenting runbooks and coordinating resolution.
